<b>Ce que fait LCNDA</b> : rien n’est an: What LCNDA does: nothing is analysed or sent. The tab is for storing information (for example results obtained legally abroad, by a relative living outside France, in a medical or research setting, or details given by other people) and for understanding what cM, segments and a haplogroup mean.
<b>Données sensibles</b> : l’ADN révèle: Sensitive data: DNA reveals things about you and your family (parents, siblings, children, cousins), who haven’t consented. Identification by genetic fingerprinting is reserved for the courts and a few cases set out by law (article 16-11). Requesting such a test outside these cases — for example ordering a genealogy test online — is punished by a fine of €3,750 (Penal Code, article 226-28-1), even if the laboratory is abroad.
